    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")

    # Return the patch in the middle

    return middle_patch

    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    
    # If no girls are found, return a message indicating so
    if not girl_patches:
        return "No girls found in the image."

    girl_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: abs(patch.left + patch.right - image_patch.left - image_patch.right))

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all patches of 'man'
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")

    # If no man is found, return a message
    if not man_patches:

    # Sort the man patches by their left coordinates
    man_patches.sort(key=lambda man: man.left)

    middle = image_patch.right / 2

        return closest_guy
    else:
        return closest_girl
